title: Small Business Website Development in India | Nested Space
description: Websites for small businesses across India. ₹2,000 starter build with hosting included, WhatsApp contact and review before payment. Only the domain costs extra.
h1: A first website for your small business.
heroCopy: Show what you offer. Give customers a place to find the details. We build mobile-friendly websites for shops, independent professionals and service businesses across India.
priceNote: Hosting included. Only the domain costs extra.
deliveryNote: First version in 48 hours after your content is ready.

includes.title: Your business, clearly introduced
includes.text: An introduction and service or product highlights that explain your business and what you offer.

includes.title: A layout that works on phones
includes.text: Responsive sections, readable text and contact buttons designed for mobile, tablet and desktop.

includes.title: An easy way to get in touch
includes.text: WhatsApp and contact actions so visitors can ask questions, request a quote or discuss your service.

includes.title: The essentials for search
includes.text: A descriptive page title, search description and clear headings based on your business information.

includes.title: One focused revision round
includes.text: Review the first version and share your changes together so we can refine the agreed website.

includes.title: Hosting and launch support
includes.text: Hosting is included, along with deployment support and final contact-link checks after you approve the website.

audiences.title: Shops & local sellers
audiences.text: Introduce your shop, highlight a selection of products, share opening details and invite enquiries.

audiences.title: Service businesses
audiences.text: Explain what you do, where you serve customers and how to ask about availability or pricing.

audiences.title: Independent professionals
audiences.text: Bring your services, work examples and contact details together in one place you can share.

process.title: Share your brief
process.text: Send your business name, logo or colours, service details, images, contact number and any references. We agree the website content and scope before building.

process.title: Review the first version
process.text: Once the required content is ready, the 48-hour first-version timeline begins. Review the website and send one consolidated round of changes.

process.title: Approve, pay & launch
process.text: Pay for the agreed starter build after approval. We help with deployment and check that customers can reach you through the website.

faqs.question: How much does a small business website cost?
faqs.answer: Our starter website build costs ₹2,000, with hosting included. Only the domain costs extra. We agree the website content and scope before building. Online payments, booking systems and other integrations need a separate quote based on your requirements.

faqs.question: What does the ₹2,000 package include?
faqs.answer: A responsive business website with an introduction, service or product highlights, contact and WhatsApp actions, basic SEO setup, hosting, one focused revision round and deployment support. We agree the website content and scope before building.

faqs.question: Is the website live within 48 hours?
faqs.answer: The 48-hour timeline is for the first version, starting after the required content is ready. Your review, revisions, approval and domain or hosting setup affect the final launch date.

faqs.question: Can we work together if my business is outside Kerala?
faqs.answer: Yes. Nested Space is based in Kozhikode and serves small businesses across India. You can share your brief and review the website remotely through our contact and WhatsApp flow.

faqs.question: Is this a complete online store?
faqs.answer: The starter is a business website with an enquiry path. A shopping cart, online checkout, inventory, customer accounts or a booking system needs a separately scoped project.

faqs.question: What do I need to provide?
faqs.answer: Your business name, logo or preferred colours, an explanation of your offer, service or product details, images you can use, contact details and any reference websites. We confirm the required content with you before the first-version timeline starts.

faqs.question: Do I pay before seeing the website?
faqs.answer: For the starter package, you review the agreed first version before payment. One focused revision round is included. Larger projects have their own scope and payment terms.

faqs.question: Can I request updates after the website is finished?
faqs.answer: After-launch updates are available for an additional charge, agreed for the requested changes.

faqs.question: How do I send a website request?
faqs.answer: Use the website request form to share your business details. It opens WhatsApp with your message prepared. Review it and send it there to contact Nested Space.
